notes.title: Fight with love - big update
notes.content:
Major changes:

Sentence mechanic
    Confusing panel replaced by colorful card slots. You can put any card in any slot, but if you'll manage 
    to match the slots conditions (colors) you'll get significant boost.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37399049/056893ed13b7eefe10911b11f6076a2b3d1c84ea.png
Battle tutorials
    On the start of the first battle in the run you'll get tutorial tool-tips about fight basics and about items. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37399049/f381b4356c1c92ec29b8a4f43e79c6208bdf9ab1.png
Action bosses are optional now
    You can choose between action sex scenes (boss fight) or card battle sex scenes.  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37399049/a4d444be42e36211ad78c3903f78e29948e8b22f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37399049/eb6879625ea4bdbde9b2a6b996d49adb4de83196.jpg

Small changes: 

 Power mechanic added to the game
 Power buffs reworked
 New mechanic added - Lovers can add useless cards to the players deck (rare for now)
 Card balance slightly reworked.
 All lovers start from 1 card on 1 date and scales to 3 cards on 3 date. 
 Moon blinks and car wheels rotates in the main menu.

notes.title: Fight with love on Steam Game Festival + DEMO update!
notes.content:
Hi, dear lovers! 
Welcome Fight with love on Steam game fest! 

Fight with love is a deck building card game about dating and abusive relationships! 
You can date your lovers - girls, boys, trans people - you choose! 
But the date is not a simple task. You need to fight with cards and manage your communication mechanics, because dating is all about communication. And if you'll succeed in enough dates you'll have wonderful sex in Bossfight scene! 

You can check Fight with love demo for free and don't forget to Wishlist Fight with love!



<3<3<3
